cards.claim: Progressive image size increase during training improves training speed but causes accuracy drop
cards.conditions: ImageNet training with EfficientNetV2; progressive resize strategy
cards.effect: Accuracy drop (magnitude unspecified); training time improvement (measured relative to baseline)
cards.evidence: Experimental observation from EfficientNetV2 training studies
cards.quote: Our training can be further sped up by progressively increasing the image size during training, but it often causes a drop in accuracy.

cards.claim: Adaptive regularization adjustment (dropout, data augmentation) can recover accuracy loss from progressive training while maintaining speed gains
cards.conditions: ImageNet training with EfficientNetV2; combined progressive image size with adaptive regularization
cards.effect: Recovers accuracy drop from progressive training; achieves both fast training and good accuracy simultaneously
cards.evidence: Experimental validation on ImageNet, CIFAR, Cars, Flowers datasets
cards.quote: To compensate for this accuracy drop, we propose to adaptively adjust regularization (e.g., dropout and data augmentation) as well, such that we can achieve both fast training and good accuracy.

cards.quote: we use a combination of training-aware neural architecture search and scaling, to jointly optimize training speed and parameter efficiency.
